description: Creates or updates a draft for exactly one explicit subject. Can set Marketplace presentation and default-deny capabilities, then optionally publish. Set regenerateHeroImage=true to generate and upload fresh artwork through the website GPT Image 2.5 service (one paid generation, 5/day). Existing artwork stays until replacement succeeds. An account publication contains no strategies. A strategy publication contains only that strategy and an optional account performance projection.

allowTradeReasonView.description: Explicit consent to publish private trade explanations in Community.

autoPublishTrades.description: Explicit consent to automatically post future confirmed fills in Community. Requires filled-trade visibility.

regenerateHeroImage.description: Regenerate and upload artwork using the same service as website Settings. Do not combine with removeHeroImage.

name: save_marketplace_publication
title: Create or update an account or strategy publication
